description: NEG-03 — /window:9..3 where stop < start (inverted range). Invalid-by-construction. Asserts [HIMA_ERROR:INVALID_WINDOW_RANGE] is emitted and no spine stage opens. The engine must never auto-swap or silently normalise the range.

turns.text: Activate window:9..3. Run from stage 9 back to stage 3.

neg.invariant: window:S..E where E < S is structurally invalid. Must emit [HIMA_ERROR:INVALID_WINDOW_RANGE]. Auto-normalising to window:3..9 is a silent-substitution defect (core.md §3: 'visible error > silent substitution').
neg.expectedBehavior: [HIMA_ERROR:INVALID_WINDOW_RANGE] in transcript. Zero spine stages open.
neg.ref: GOAL-3.md §3 window validation — start ≤ stop invariant; core.md §3 no silent fallbacks
